annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores across four different conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick marks at intervals of 2 starting from 2. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" with a linear scale ranging from 20 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The plot features four lines. The line in purple with circle markers represents "Consistency-CE" and is dashed; it starts at approximately 20 at the x-value of 0 and increases steadily, reaching slightly below 30 at the x-value of 8. The line in dark purple with square markers represents "Inconsistency-CE" and is also dashed; it begins at slightly above 22 at the x-value of 1 and increases to approximately 30 at the x-value of 8. The line in blue with square markers represents "Inconsistency-CE-MP" and is dashed too; starting at 22 at the x-value of 0, it reaches around 29 at the x-value of 8. Finally, the red line with star markers represents "Consistency-Bi" and is solid; it begins at 25 at the x-value of 1 and progresses to slightly above 30 at the x-value of 8. Dark blue intersects the dark purple line at an x-value of 2 and the purple line at an x-value of 6. All lines show an upward trend with variations in the rate of increase. A legend is available on the bottom right of the plot to infer different lines by their styles.
